doc.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Jymie Merritt and the bass tradition
summary: Fuller praises Jymie Merritt as underrated and compares Ron Carter, Paul Chambers and Ray Brown.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Oh, great bass player. Underrated. He's from that Ron Carter mold. Ron look, later developed this technique of soloing and getting his things, you know, he didn't have to do Paul Chambers’ style with those and all that (scats frenetic bass
solo). He didn’t have to go there. It was more like the master, like Ray Brown could just take one hand and (scats solo). He was telling stories, and painting pictures.
